// Generated by fizzyx. Safe to customize through configureAdminApi.

import {
  configure,
  setHeaders,
  setToken,
  type ClientConfig,
} from "@/lib/api/generated"

export interface AdminApiConfig extends ClientConfig {
  token?: string | null
}

export function configureAdminApi({ token, headers, ...config }: AdminApiConfig): void {
  configure(config)
  if (headers) setHeaders(headers)
  if (token !== undefined) setToken(token)
}

// Keep the raw OpenAPI response shape so generated TypeScript types and admin data paths agree.
configureAdminApi({ baseUrl: {{FIZZYX_API_BASE_URL}}, responseExtractor: (raw) => raw })
